snippet.title: Killgore EP1
snippet.description:
Killgore rolls up to Happy Cow meat factory with a machine gun and bad intentions. 
Killgore Crowd Funding Campaign coming soon! https://www.facebook.com/killgoreanimation

Written, Animated & Directed by Joseph E.A. King    http://josephkingworks.blogspot.com/
Music Composed by Johnny Knittle    http://johnnyrk.com/
Rerecording Mixer / Sound Design by Barry Weir Jr.
Logo Design by Luis Betancourt    www.lebetancourt.com
